title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?
abstract: arXiv:2610.41267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Turning an engineering request into a simulation requires consistent geometry, physics, boundary conditions, and numerical settings. Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information. We study whether agents can reliably construct complete executable JSON specifications for automated geometry creation, meshing, PDE solving, and result export. Our workflow combines model extraction with deterministic scientific and capability checks, explicit clarification, and validated local patches that preserve unrelated accepted fields. We evaluate specification correctness, execution completion, and numerical verification separately. translated_title: 从一维基准测试到复杂三维几何：智能体能否可靠地为自动化PDE仿真指定问题？
translated_abstract: 将工程需求转化为仿真，需要几何、物理、边界条件和数值设置之间保持一致。近期的智能体辅助系统实现了仿真设置的自动化，但仅仅成功执行并不能确定该规范是否保留了原本预期的问题，或是否正确处理了缺失的信息。我们研究智能体能否可靠地构建完整、可执行的JSON规范，用于自动化几何创建、网格划分、PDE求解和结果导出。我们的工作流程将模型提取与确定性的科学和能力检查、显式澄清以及经过验证的局部补丁（保留无关的已接受字段）相结合。我们分别评估规范正确性、执行完成度和数值验证。在120个与模板相关的请求上，完整的工作流程实现了98.3%的首轮规范与决策结果正确率，相比之下，基于模式辅助的方法为92.5%。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个结合确定性科学与能力检查、显式澄清和经验证的局部补丁的工作流程，使智能体能够为自动化PDE仿真可靠地生成完整可执行的问题规范，并在120个请求上达到98.3%的首轮正确率。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a workflow combining deterministic scientific and capability checks, explicit clarification, and validated local patches, enabling agents to reliably generate complete, executable problem specifications for automated PDE simulation, achieving 98.3% first-turn correctness on 120 requests.
